description: Cut 2-12 of the customer's own video clips together into one finished video (or several shorter ones with clipCount), exactly like "Ladda upp klipp" on the Shoots page: the clips are saved as a project and edited in the order given. Use it whenever the customer sends or points at two or more videos and wants them as one video, a reel, or a few clips cut from them; use process_video for a single video. Editing their own footage costs no video credits. Renders in the background (usually 2-10 minutes) into draft posts in Att göra; returns postId and taskId. Never say it is finished — check get_task_status.

clipCount.description: How many finished videos to cut from the footage (1-10, default 1). Above 1 needs editMode "highlights".

editMode.description: full (default): every clip, in order. highlights: only the best moments — use only when the customer asks for a shorter or highlight cut.

editingStyle.description: creative (default): hook, subtitles, music in time with the cuts, pauses cut, zoom-ins, call to action. captions: the footage exactly as filmed, with subtitles only.

music.description: Background music. Creative edits have it on by default.

musicStyle.description: What the music should sound like, in words.

prompt.description: The customer's brief in their own words: what the video is about, who it is for, what to keep or emphasise.

targetDuration.description: Seconds per finished video: "15", "30", "45", "60", or "source" to keep the length. Omit for the editor's choice.

targetPlatforms.description: Channels to prepare the post for. Omit for all connected channels.

template.description: Creative only. A template the customer asked for: hype, trailer, tutorial, commercial, news, kinetic, story, testimonial. Omit to let the editor choose.

title.description: Short project name, e.g. "Julmarknaden i Gamla stan". Shown in Shoots.

videoUrls.description: 2-12 public http(s) video URLs, in the order they should appear in the finished video.

voice.description: Narration voice; "own" is the customer's own cloned voice.

voiceover.description: AI narration: only for footage where nobody speaks.

name: combine_videos
